'''WraithHold Mandalorian Etiquette''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[WraithHold]]
* '''Published:''' 27 May 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Any Methods Necessary|ECC-D-anymethodsnecessary.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Vile WraithHold DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Boba Fett (V) (Virtual Set 6), Lando Calrissian (V) (Virtual Set 6), Rodian (V) (Virtual Set 3), Reegesk (V) (Virtual Set 3), Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle (V) (Virtual Set 6), Jabba's Influence (V) (Virtual Set 6), Krayt Dragon Bones (V) (Virtual Set 4), Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Set 5), He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (V) (Virtual Set 6): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

Tired of prepared defenses, I decided to try something with one of the other starting interrupts.

== Notes ==

* Four creatures under Fear Is My Ally, outside the 60: Sarlacc, Bubo, Wampa (V) (VS4), One-Arm (V) (VS4).
* Original-era (V) slips: Boba Fett and his Blaster Rifle (VS6), Lando Calrissian (VS6), Rodian/Reegesk (VS3), Jabba's Influence (VS6), Krayt Dragon Bones (VS4), Defensive Fire x3 (VS5), He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (VS6); shields I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing (VS2), Reactor Terminal (VS3), Firepower (VS6).
* Posted 'Galid' dested Gailid; 'Any Methods Nescessary' Any Methods Necessary.

== Strategy ==

The strategy for this is pretty simple, hold the tatooine sites while capturing anybody that tries to come in.

First turn, you should be able to get Fett, his gun, scum, and Lando out. With hidden weapons, defensive fires, and the none shall pass they should be safe for a while. From that, just keep setting up drains untill they decide to come to tatooine.

If they show up, Fett should have no problem capturing them for a quick feeding to the rancor or Sarlac. If that doesn't work, I imagine a loss will follow very quickly.
